research_rationale:
EO 12348 (February 25, 1982) established the Property Review Board and set Federal real property review duties for the Board, the Administrator of General Services and executive agencies, and revoked EO 11954 (Sec. 8). It has no own-terms sunset. EO 12512 of April 29, 1985 states in its Sec. 4 that Executive Order No. 12348 of February 25, 1982 "is hereby revoked", and replaces the framework with a new real property management order. The status is NO: the order was expressly and wholly revoked on April 29, 1985 and no held source revives it.

savings.reason: The held text of EO 12512 revokes EO 12348 in Sec. 4 without a clause preserving the Property Review Board, its targets or its survey duties; EO 12512 establishes new policy through the Domestic Policy Council and the Office of Management and Budget. The revocation of EO 11954 in Sec. 8 of EO 12348 was complete on signing and is not revived. Bounded searches of the U.S. Code, eCFR and the OFR catalog found no continuing reliance on EO 12348.
